publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.22 pins @runeditrun/rer 0.2.129. A clean local launch gets a separate five-minute Chromium provisioning budget before the owner-readiness check, so the first rer dev can reach the private RER_OPEN sign-in link. The console loads Add destination with Alerts and keeps the monitor toolbar available when you return to Monitors while Alerts is still loading. All 91 SQL migrations from 0.5.21 are byte-identical. This release adds zero migration files and zero required settings. Existing monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are retained. Back up first through Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup if applicable. For local CLI backup, verify the native session while dev is running, then stop dev and use the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE to run rer export --output exports/uptime.rer within five minutes. Keep the cookie private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, stop dev or preview and deploy as usual. Keep the deployment receipt and use the existing installation keys. The mail enable/disable commands, legacy SendGrid selector guidance and known limits in the changelog still apply. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png, captured on 0.4.0. — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-22.
